name: gauss-www
description: Import-ready Gauss subsite framework for df12-www

scripts.build: bun run build:static && bun run build:css
scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k -n watch,serve -c blue,green "bunx chokidar-cli 'src/**/*' 'templates/**/*' 'config/**/*' 'scripts/**/*' 'package.json' '../df12-www/df12_pages/**/*' '../df12-www/config/shared/**/*' '../df12-www/config/pages.yaml' '../df12-www/pyproject.toml' --initial -i '**/*.pyc' -i '**/__pycache__/**' -c 'bun run build:dev'" "bunx http-server .preview -p ${DF12_PORT:-8080} -c-1"
